{{Quote|Stay and play in the clouds and enjoy the spectacular Fantasy in the Sky fireworks pageant every single night!|Star Tours commercial|<ref name="COM">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/celebration_v_startourspromo/index.html|text=New Star Tours "Commercial"}}</ref>}}
The '''Fantasy in the Sky''' fireworks pageant was a regular celebration which took place on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and revolved around the use of [[Fireworks/Legends|pyrotechnic displays]]. This festivity was used as an advertising attraction by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency for their [[Star Tours Getaway Package]].<ref name="COM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fantasy in the Sky fireworks pageant was mentioned in an [[in-universe]] commercial created for the queue area of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''&mdash;a reimagined [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction in [[Disneyland]] Park and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]]. In an earlier version of the advertisement released online to promote the new ride, the show was called "Galaxy in the Skies", but the new name was introduced in the video shown in the ride queue itself.<ref name="WhereInSpace">{{DPB|url=2010/08/new-star-tours-video-makes-us-ask-where-will-the-new-star-tours-attraction-take-us|text=New Star Tours Video Makes Us Ask: Where Will the New Star Tours Attraction Take Us?}}</ref>  It is likely a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Fantasy in the Sky|Fantasy in the Sky]] fireworks performance shown at various [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] theme parks for many years.<ref name="D23 Fantasy">{{D23|url=a-to-z/fantasy-in-the-sky|text=Disney A to Z: Fantasy in the Sky}}</ref>
